records.translated_title: Where the Mind is Without Fear
What Shall I Gain in Life?
Listen to the Story of the House
On the Face like the Moon
As Soon as I Step Out
What Should I Do With Your Sympathy

records.poem_title: Jo Beet Gayi So Baat Gayi

records.translated_title: We Are Birds of Free Sky
There Will Be Sunlight on the Journey
On the Face Like the Moon

records.poem_title: Kahin Door Jab Din Dhal Jaaye

records.translated_title: What Should I Forget, What to Remember
Listen to the Talk of the House
The Daughter of a Big House

records.poem_title: Jeevan Se Yehi Naa Umeed Thi
records.translated_title: This Was Not the Hope from Life
The Seventh Horse of the Sun
In the Window Across from Me
I Am Not Angry with You, Life
Who is the Thief of My City?
The Clay Speaks to the Potter
What Shall I Do with Your Compassion
The Seventh Horse of the Sun
The Big Shadow of the Moon

records.poem_title: Kahin Door Jab Din Dhal Jaaye
Har Ek Baat Pe Kahte Ho Tum

records.translated_title: What Kind of Freedom is This

records.poem_title: Jo Beet Gayi So Baat Gayi
Kuchh Paane Ki Ho Aas Aas

records.translated_title: The Rider of the Blue Horse
The Trot of the Black Horse
As Many People, So Many Loves

records.poem_title: Aaj Phir Chaand Ki Yaad Aayi

records.translated_title: There Will Be Sun on the Journey
I Am the Wave of the Ganga
How Long Shall I Remain Alone?
Look at the City from Here
Look at the City from Here
There Will Be Sun on the Way

records.poem_title: Tum Itna Jo Muskura Rahe Ho

records.translated_title: The Night is Not Yet Over
There Will Be Sunshine on the Journey
The Lonely Man in the Crowd
As Soon as I Step Out
The Tune of Days Gone By
Wave by Wave, Bottle by Bottle
How Long Shall I Be Alone?

records.poem_title: Manzil Se Jyada Safar Pyara Hai
records.translated_title: The Journey is Dearer than the Destination
Our Spring Is Because of You
There Will Be Sunlight on the Way
Look at the City from Here
Look at the City from Here
Who Knows Who the Player Is
Who Knows What They Were Like
How Many More Lamps to Light
The Woman on the White Horse
The Clay Speaks to the Potter

records.poem_title: Yahan Tha Kabhi Sita Ka Vanvaas

records.translated_title: What to Forget, What to Remember
The Long Journey of a Ghazal
The Stone Flying in the Wind
records.translator:
हवाओं में उड़ता पत्थर,  
राहों की तलाश करता है।  
ना उसे रुकने की जगह मिलती है,  
ना मंजिल का पता चलता है।

records.translator: George L. Hart and Hank Heifetz

records.translated_title: The Song That Comes with the Wind
O Moon, Don’t Come Near Me
Every Place is My Home, Every Person is My Kin
A Flower Given by a God
The Life of a Beautiful One
I Will Give You in My Eyes
The Flavor of the Wandering Eyes
In the Eyes of the Maiden
To the Breeze and the Flower
The New Eyes of the Maiden
In the Eyes of a Companion
In the Eyes of the Breeze

records.poet: B. K. B. S. Rajendra Rao

records.translated_title: It has been after a long time
When I See You, My Dear
Red Blood Is Becoming Thin Now...
The Eternal Flow of the Ganges
The Depth and Flow of Rivers
The Call of the Gentle Ones
The Primacy of Virtue Over Caste
The Nature of the Rat's Skin
The Tale of the Lowly Breed
The Tale of the Lowly Breed
The Power of Righteousness Over Strength
The Nature of Wealth and Kinship
Where Gold Sits on Every Leaf
The First Love as It Was
